source.author: Henriette Davidis
source.title: A Practical Book of the Art of Cooking as Performed in Germany (Milwaukee, Wis.: C. N. Caspar Co., Book Emporium)

tablespoonful.read: The source is an American edition (title page: "Compiled and adapted for the United States, according to the Thirty-fifth German Original, with Weights and Measures in American equivalents"); taken as the US customary tablespoon of units.json (14.78676478125 ml). A judgement.

cupful.read: The source is an American edition (title page: "Compiled and adapted for the United States, according to the Thirty-fifth German Original, with Weights and Measures in American equivalents"); taken as the US customary cup of units.json (236.5882365 ml). A judgement.

sourceNote.en: The source allows fine flour or cornstarch.
sourceNote.de: Die Quelle lässt feinstes Mehl oder Stärke zu.

note.en: Large cupful of warm milk, mixed with a little water.
note.de: Groß. Warme Milch, mit etwas Wasser verdünnt.

text.en: Beat the eggs, the starch, the milk with a little water, the mace and the salt thoroughly.
text.de: Eier, Stärke, Milch mit etwas Wasser, Muskatblüte und Salz gründlich schlagen.

text.en: Melt the butter in the pan over low heat.
text.de: Die Butter bei schwacher Hitze in der Pfanne schmelzen.

text.en: Pour in the batter and spread it with a spoon.
text.de: Den Teig in die Pfanne gießen und mit dem Löffel verteilen.

text.en: Cook over low heat until the top is dry and the edge has come away from the pan. It stays very soft: do not turn it.
text.de: Bei schwacher Hitze garen, bis die Oberseite trocken ist und sich am Rand von der Pfanne löst. Sie bleibt ganz weich: nicht wenden.

text.en: Sprinkle sugar and cinnamon over it.
Put it on a plate and fold it.
text.de: Auf einen Teller legen und zusammenschlagen.

settled.reason: Our judgement: the source names no number of persons; the recipe is for 8 eggs.

check.note: Second check against the German 1897 Milwaukee edition (scan davidis.txt, lines 29090-29099, recipe 6, Nr. 1). Agreed: 8 eggs, 1 heaped spoon of starch or fine flour, mace, salt, butter, sugar, cinnamon, the steps. Differs: the German says oblong dish (längliche Schüssel), the English plate; the English is used. Milk amount not legible in the German scan (",t Qt"); it rests on the English edition alone.

note.en: The plain version only; the variants with cranberries and smoked meat or tongue are not transcribed. The low heat is stated in the German edition of the book only.
note.de: Nur die einfache Form; die Varianten mit Preiselbeeren sowie Rauchfleisch oder Zunge sind nicht übertragen. Die schwache Hitze steht nur in der deutschen Ausgabe des Buches.
